in_marathi.name: Kethavath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kethavath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Kethavath is the name of Lord Vishnu in his form as the preserver of the universe. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Kethu' meaning 'fortune' and 'Vath' meaning 'lord'. Kethavath is believed to bestow good fortune, prosperity, and protection upon his devotees.
